families.source: HSE construction-dust and respirable crystalline silica guidance
families.topic: assessment and control of silica, non-silica and wood dust generated by construction work
families.guard: Construction-dust risk depends on material composition, task, duration, control equipment, ventilation, RPE fit, housekeeping and measured exposure.

families.topic: avoidance, extraction, respiratory protection, maintenance, surveillance and training for welding fume
families.guard: Welding-fume risk depends on process, material and coating, duration, position, enclosure, LEV capture, ventilation, RPE selection and worker technique.

families.topic: mist, skin exposure, bacterial contamination, control maintenance and health surveillance
families.guard: Metalworking-fluid risk depends on fluid chemistry, mist generation, bacterial condition, concentration, pH, enclosure, LEV, skin contact and surveillance findings.

families.source: HSE occupational dermatitis and skin-exposure guidance
families.topic: recognition, prevention and control of irritant and allergic occupational skin disease
families.guard: Dermatitis risk depends on substance, wet-work duration, concentration, contact route, glove choice, hygiene, individual sensitisation and early health-surveillance findings.

families.topic: heat-load assessment, symptoms, engineering controls, exposure limitation, training and acclimatisation
families.guard: Heat-stress risk depends on environmental heat, humidity, air movement, metabolic workload, clothing, hydration, acclimatisation and individual medical susceptibility.

families.source: HSE work-related stress Management Standards guidance
families.topic: risk assessment and prevention across demands, control, support, relationships, role and change
families.guard: Work-related stress risk depends on work design, workload, autonomy, support, relationships, role clarity, organisational change and individual circumstances.

families.source: HSE work-related violence and aggression guidance
families.topic: definition, legal duties, assessment, controls, reporting, learning and worker support
families.guard: Violence risk depends on work activity, contact with the public, lone working, time, location, authority, valuables, prior incidents, staffing and control effectiveness.

families.topic: user scope, workstation assessment, breaks, eye tests, posture and training
families.guard: Display-screen risk depends on duration, workstation geometry, posture, input devices, vision needs, lighting, breaks, mobility and individual health factors.

families.source: HSE home-working health and safety guidance
families.topic: risk assessment, communication, DSE, work environment, stress and alternative arrangements
families.guard: Home-working risk depends on the task, duration, equipment, workstation, domestic environment, isolation, communication, disability needs and ability to implement controls.

families.source: HSE pregnant-worker and new-mother protection guidance
families.topic: individual risk assessment, controls, alternative work, suspension, review and night work
families.guard: Pregnancy and new-mother risk depends on pregnancy stage, medical advice, task, posture, hours, substances, temperature, noise, infection, work changes and individual condition.

families.topic: additional risk factors, assessment, instruction, training, supervision and age restrictions
families.guard: Young-worker risk depends on age, maturity, experience, physical development, task, environment, training comprehension, supervision and equipment restrictions.

families.source: HSE migrant-worker health and safety guidance
families.topic: equal protection, employer communication and training, worker duties and confidential concern reporting
families.guard: Migrant-worker risk depends on task, employment arrangements, language and literacy, training comprehension, supervision, accommodation, transport and ability to raise concerns.

families.source: HSE older-worker health and safety guidance
families.topic: age-neutral assessment, consultation, training, work design and use of experience
families.guard: Older-worker risk depends on individual capability and health, task design, physical demand, training method, working pattern, workplace change and available technology.

families.topic: inclusive risk assessment, individual consultation, adjustments, specialist advice and disclosure
families.guard: Disabled-worker risk and adjustment needs depend on the individual, impairment effects, task, environment, communication, equipment, barriers and agreed support.
